heading.title: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts

article.title: Three years.
article.content:
Article50Three years.

The Schedule  ·  First Division—Suits · Part II—Suits Relating to Contracts
By the manager of a joint estate of an undivided family for contribution, in respect of a payment made by him on account of the estate.
Period of limitationThree years.

Time from which period begins to runThe date of the payment.
